characters.name: Captain Bramblebeard

leaderSkill.name: The Watch Never Blinks
leaderSkill.desc: Meadow Watch allies HP x2 and ATK x2. All other allies HP x1.3.

activeSkill.name: Shield Wall Protocol
activeSkill.desc: Shield the party and taunt enemies toward the Captain.

passive.name: First In, Last Out
passive.desc: Takes the first hit of every battle at half damage.

awakened.abilityDesc: Shield Wall Protocol also heals the party. His beard now contains a lookout post.

characters.flavor: Founded the Meadow Watch after the Gerald Incident. Motto: 'Somebody has to.' Membership: anyone who shows up twice.

characters.name: Luna

leaderSkill.name: One Leg, Full Power
leaderSkill.desc: At 4+ combo, Nature allies ATK x2.2.

activeSkill.name: Pink Plastic Judgment
activeSkill.desc: Convert Dark orbs to Nature orbs. The lawn has spoken.

passive.name: Weatherproof
passive.desc: Immune to poison orb damage. She has stood through worse.

characters.flavor: Stood motionless in one yard for forty years, absorbing lawn magic. The Wraithwood HOA banned her. She considers this her villain origin.

characters.name: Compost Carl

activeSkill.name: Turn the Pile
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party and cleanse poisoned and locked orbs. Nothing is wasted.

passive.name: Rich Soil
passive.desc: Heals 3% HP whenever any orbs are cleansed or unlocked.

characters.flavor: Mulch Wizard Randy's compost heap achieved independence. They remain close. It's beautiful, and it smells exactly like you think.

characters.name: Twiggy

leaderSkill.name: Reckless Growth
leaderSkill.desc: Nature allies ATK x2, but party REC x0.7. Twiggy accepts no responsibility.

activeSkill.name: Stick Shuffle
activeSkill.desc: Shuffle the entire board into a new arrangement. Twiggy calls it 'redecorating'.

passive.name: Small Target
passive.desc: 15% chance to dodge attacks. Extremely twig-shaped.

characters.flavor: A stick? A spirit? A very committed squirrel? Nobody has confirmed. Twiggy thrives on ambiguity and stolen snacks.

characters.name: Judge Lumen

leaderSkill.name: Order in the Court
leaderSkill.desc: While party HP is above 80%: all allies ATK x2.5.

activeSkill.name: Objection Sustained
activeSkill.desc: Shield the party and unlock all locked orbs. Overruled, ALL of it.

passive.name: Contempt Citations
passive.desc: Enemies that bind allies take +30% damage from Lumen.

awakened.epithet: Supreme Justice of the Dawn Circuit
awakened.abilityDesc: Objection Sustained also delays all enemies by 1. Court is in session until SHE says otherwise.

characters.flavor: Presides over the court that handles crimes committed after midnight. Her gavel is a small sunrise. Her rulings are FINAL.

characters.name: Glowstick Greg
characters.epithet: Snap Him and He Only Gets Brighter

leaderSkill.name: Rave Logic
leaderSkill.desc: At 5+ combo: all allies ATK x1.8 and +1 second movement time.

activeSkill.name: Glow Harder
activeSkill.desc: Extend movement time by 3 seconds and convert 2 orbs to Light.

passive.name: Single Use (Refuses)
passive.desc: Survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP. He is NOT done glowing.

characters.flavor: Every glowstick burns out eventually. Greg heard this and simply declined. He has been at the party for nine years.

characters.name: Beacon Betty

activeSkill.name: Flare Protocol
activeSkill.desc: Convert Dark orbs to Light orbs. The Watch sees everything.

passive.name: High Ground
passive.desc: +10% ATK when in slot 1 or 5. She likes the edges. Better sightlines.

characters.flavor: Operates the meadow's signal tower: one lantern, two flags, and a truly piercing whistle she is legally barred from using indoors.

characters.name: Brandy
characters.epithet: Certified Rescue Dog, Uncertified Good Girl (She Is Though)

activeSkill.name: Emergency Snuggle
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party a large amount. Morale restored to dangerous levels.

passive.name: Loyal
passive.desc: When the leader falls below 50% HP, Brandy's REC doubles.

characters.flavor: Rescued 200 travelers from the mountain. The barrel on her collar contains not brandy, but emergency biscuits. For everyone.

characters.name: Auntie Umbra
characters.epithet: Manager of the Void (She Brought Snacks)

leaderSkill.name: Void Hospitality
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies ATK x2 and REC x2. Guests are FED.

activeSkill.name: Midnight Snacks
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party generously. The void provides. The void insists.

passive.name: Seconds?
passive.desc: Heart matches also charge Dark allies' skills.

awakened.epithet: Grand Hostess of the Hungering Dark
awakened.abilityDesc: Midnight Snacks also converts Heart orbs to Dark orbs after healing. Waste not.

characters.flavor: Runs the administrative side of the endless void. Every lost soul gets a casserole and a stern talking-to. Attendance at dinner is not optional.

characters.name: The Understudy

leaderSkill.name: Waiting in the Wings
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies ATK x1.8. The ally in slot 5 gains ATK x2.2 instead.

activeSkill.name: Dramatic Pause
activeSkill.desc: Delay all enemies by 2. The silence is DEVASTATING.

passive.name: Knows Every Line
passive.desc: Copies 20% of the leader's ATK as bonus ATK.

characters.flavor: Has understudied the kingdom's greatest hero for 11 years. The hero never misses a show. The Understudy waits. The Understudy is PATIENT.

characters.name: Gary the Gloom Goose

leaderSkill.name: No Brakes
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies ATK x2, but they cannot be healed above 70% HP. Gary lives dangerously.

activeSkill.name: UNTETHERED HONK
activeSkill.desc: Deal heavy Dark damage to one enemy. The sound follows them forever.

passive.name: Menace
passive.desc: +20% ATK against enemies that have already acted this battle. Grudges.

characters.flavor: Not related to Gary the Kraken. Both Garys deny each other's existence. The lake they share is VERY tense.

characters.name: Nadia Nightlight
characters.epithet: Reformed Night Terror, Meadow Watch Night Shift

leaderSkill.name: Nothing Under the Bed
leaderSkill.desc: All allies take 10% less damage. She checked.

activeSkill.name: Comforting Darkness
activeSkill.desc: Shield the party. The dark is on YOUR side tonight.

passive.name: Night Shift
passive.desc: Takes 20% less damage from Dark enemies. Professional courtesy, revoked.

characters.flavor: Spent centuries lurking under beds before realizing she preferred guarding them. The Meadow Watch's only member with a union-mandated nap.
